name: the-breakroom
description: The backend server for The Breakroom, a social platform designed for workers in retail, customer service, and other public-facing roles.

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run start --prefix client"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.format: concurrently "npm run format --prefix server" "npm run format --prefix client"

author: Zachary Baca
